Posted 'Nobel Sac' dested Noble Sacrifice; 'OofC/TT' dested Out Of Commission & Transmission Terminated; 'Weapon Lev' dested the Light Jabba's Palace interrupt Weapon Levitation (Jabba's Palace); 'Lukes Stick' dested Luke's Lightsaber; 'Lando w/axe' dested Lando With Vibro-Ax; 'Wedge Antillies' dested the Premiere Wedge Antilles; 'Captin Han Solo' dested Captain Han Solo; 'Night Fall' dested Nightfall.
What're You Tryin' To Push On Us? is posted under Interrupts; the card is an Effect.
Patrol Craft x2 is posted under 'Blue6' (starships); the card is a Vehicle. The section headers 'Admirals Orders2', 'Green3' (weapons) and 'Blue6' (starships) are not cards.
Credited to the existing page Nate Meeker (2006 World Champion) as the same name; nothing on the page links or contradicts the 2001 Ohio result.
